articles.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
articles.excerpt: Learn how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call. Added as a gateway interceptor, Skyflow de-identifies data before any tool, model, or log sees it, and restores it for authorized callers, with no change to your agent code.

image.alt: Reference architecture with the Skyflow interceptor Lambda function between Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and the tools, reading its policy from Parameter Store and its API key from Secrets Manager

fa.title: محافظت از ابزار عامل تماس با Skyflow و Amazon Bedrock Agent Gateway
